keyword: what time will the masters end on sunday
claims: The 2026 Masters final round is scheduled to conclude on Sunday, April 12.
CBS broadcasts the final round from 2:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET.
The final group (Rory McIlroy and Cameron Young) tees off at 2:25 p.m. ET.
Early Sunday streaming begins on Paramount+ and Masters.com at noon ET.
The Green Jacket Ceremony takes place immediately following the conclusion of play.
